Terms & Conditions

This Affiliate Program Operating Agreement (the "Agreement") is made and entered into by and between Grammarly.com ("Grammarly.com", “Grammarly”, “our”, “us”, or "we"), and the party submitting an application to become a Grammarly.com affiliate ("you" or "Affiliate") (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”). The terms and conditions contained in this Agreement apply to your participation in Has Offers (grammarly.hasoffers.com), Commission Junction, Partner Stack, or Share-A-Sale (each, an "Affiliate Program"). Each Affiliate Program offer (an "Offer") may be for any offering by Grammarly.com or a third party (each such third party a "Client") and may link to a specific website for that particular Offer ("Program Web Site"). Furthermore, each Offer may have additional terms and conditions on pages within the Affiliate Program and, if so, are incorporated, into and made a part of, this Agreement. By submitting an application or participating in an Offer, you expressly consent to all the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

1. Enrollment in the Affiliate Program

You must submit an Affiliate Program application from our website or within the applicable Affiliate Program website. You must accurately complete the application to become an Affiliate (and provide us with future updates) and not use any aliases or other means to mask your true identity or your contact information. After we review your application, we will notify you of your acceptance or rejection into the Affiliate Program, generally within two (2) business days of our receipt of your application. We may accept or reject your application in our sole discretion for any reason.

2. Obligations of the Parties

Subject to our acceptance of you as an Affiliate and your continued compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Grammarly.com agrees as follows:

We will make available to you via the Affiliate Program graphic and textual links to the Program Web Site and/or other creative materials (each, a “Link”, and collectively, the "Links") which you may display on websites owned or controlled by you, in emails sent by you and clearly identified as coming from you and in online advertisements (collectively, "Media"). For Grammarly Business customers, Media may include forms that can be used to submit leads directly into applications such as Salesforce or other systems that may be utilized by Grammarly from time to time. The Links will serve to identify you as a member of our Affiliate Program and will establish a link from your Media to the Program Web Site.

We will pay Affiliate for each Qualified Action (the "Commission"), provided the Affiliate is not a non-profit organization pursuant to Section 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code. A “Qualified Action" means an individual person who (i) accesses the Program Web Site via the Link, where the Link is the last link to the Program Web Site, (ii) is not a computer generated user, such as a robot, spider, computer script or other automated, artificial or fraudulent method to appear like an individual, real live person, (iii) is not using pre-populated fields (iv) completes all of the information required for such action within the time period allowed by Grammarly.com, (v) is not refunded as requested by the customer or due to a chargeback, and (vi) is not later determined by Grammarly.com to be fraudulent, incomplete, unqualified, or a duplicate.

Additionally, for the Grammarly Individual Consumer Affiliate program, there are two (2) types of Qualified Actions that can earn an Affiliate a commission: An Account Sign-Up and a Purchase. An “Account Sign-Up” is defined as the occurrence of an individual non-user creating an account on Grammarly.com or the Grammarly Mobile application by providing a valid email address that does not already exist in the Grammarly database. A “Purchase” is defined as a consumer user that upgrades to a paid Grammarly subscription. In order to qualify as a Qualified Action, both the Account Sign-Up and the Purchase must occur within ninety (90) days of the user’s first visit to Grammarly.com or to the Grammarly Mobile App via an Affiliate link. Note that Affiliate must be specifically opted into the Consumer Affiliate program to qualify. In the event that a user clicks on content from 2 separate affiliates, the last click that leads to the user conversion will receive the transaction credit.

For the Grammarly Business Affiliate program, there are three types of qualified actions: 1) Self-Serve Purchase action: Earn a Commission for each paying Grammarly Business customer with up to one hundred forty-nine (149) seats. Qualified customers must create and pay for an account via our self-service portal using a credit card. Commission is earned if the customer continues with their Grammarly Business account following their free trial. 2) Qualified Referred Lead action: Earn a Commission for every Qualified Grammarly Business referral of at least one hundred fifty (150) seats. Potential customers requiring more than one hundred fifty (150) seats will be introduced to a Grammarly sales team member. If a proposal is sent to a customer after the customer has been vetted by Grammarly, the Affiliate may earn a commission. 3) Closed Won Sale: Earn a Commission for each paying Grammarly Business customer of at least one hundred fifty (150) seats. If a customer accepts and moves forward with the proposal generated by the Grammarly Sales team, earn a Commission when the sales team marks the account as “Closed Won.” Note that Affiliate must be specifically opted into the Grammarly Business Affiliate program to qualify.

Additionally, any promotion of Grammarly or Grammarly products via Craigslist, Picoworkers.com, Micoworkers (or any similar gig site) is strictly prohibited. Affiliates also do not have permission to engage in network-to-network brokering or offering Grammarly or Grammarly products via incent strategies and placements. No phone or call center sales are permitted. There are NO exceptions to these guidelines. Anyone in breach of these restrictions will be immediately removed from the Grammarly Affiliate Program and prohibited from rejoining in the future.

Grammarly.com may chargeback fraudulent leads if such leads are returned to Affiliate within thirty (30) business days following the end of the month in which such leads were generated. Fraudulent leads are defined as any lead that is: (i) generated by means of any device, program, or robot; (ii) generated using stolen credit cards; or (iii) created by Affiliate or any third party , directly or indirectly, for the purpose of artificially inflating commissions payable to Affiliate.

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, in the event the Qualified Actions, in Grammarly’s sole reasonable opinion, do not convert into additional revenue for Grammarly at a rate substantially similar to Grammarly’s average conversion rate, then Grammarly may withhold payment of the Commission for an additional thirty (30) calendar day period, during which Affiliate will reasonably assist Grammarly in Grammarly’s investigation to determine whether the Qualified Actions are legitimate. If, in Grammarly’s sole reasonable opinion, Grammarly determines that the Qualified Actions are not legitimate, then Affiliate’s entitlement to the applicable Commission will be voided. Grammarly reserves the right to pause or terminate an Affiliate’s campaign if Affiliate traffic is deemed low-quality based on rate of user upgrades relative to other marketing channels.

Promotional offers cannot be combined with other performance incentive bonuses. If multiple bonus or promotional offers coincide, Affiliate will receive the bonus or promotional offer that is the greatest value for which they qualify.

New Grammarly.com Affiliates (Affiliates receiving payment on their first Invoice) accessing links via grammarly.hasoffers.com or from within the Affiliate Program are paid within twenty (25) days following the end of the month in which the Commission is earned. Grammarly.com shall automatically generate an invoice on behalf of Affiliate for all Commissions payable under this Agreement and shall remit payment to Affiliate based upon that invoice. All tracking of Links and determinations of Qualified Actions and Commissions shall be made by Grammarly.com at its sole discretion. In the event that Affiliate disputes in good faith any portion of an invoice, Affiliate must submit that dispute to Grammarly.com in writing and in sufficient detail within thirty (30) days of the date of the invoice. If Affiliate does not dispute the invoice as set forth in the preceding sentence, then Affiliate agrees that it irrevocably waives any claims based upon that invoice. In the event that Affiliate is also tracking Qualified Actions and Affiliate claims a discrepancy, Affiliate must provide Grammarly.com with Affiliate's reports within three (3) days following the end of the calendar month, and if Grammarly.com's and Affiliate's reported statistics vary by more than ten percent (10%) and Grammarly.com reasonably determines that Affiliate has used generally accepted industry methods to track Qualified Actions, then Grammarly.com and Affiliate agree to work together in good faith to reconcile the discrepancy. If the Parties are unable to arrive at a reconciliation, then Grammarly.com's numbers shall control.

If Affiliate has an outstanding balance due to Grammarly.com under this Agreement or any other agreement between the Affiliate and Grammarly.com, whether or not related to the Affiliate Program, Affiliate agrees that Grammarly.com may offset any such amounts due to Grammarly.com from amounts payable to Affiliate under this Agreement.

Affiliate also agrees to:

Comply with the terms, conditions, guidelines, and policies of any third-party services used by Affiliate in connection with the Affiliate Program, including but not limited to, email providers, social networking services, and ad networks.

Always prominently post and make available to end users, including prior to the collection of any personally identifiable information, a privacy policy in compliance with all applicable laws that clearly, accurately, and completely discloses all information collection, use, and sharing practices, including providing for the collection of such personally identifiable information in connection with the Affiliate Program and the provision of such personally identifiable information to Grammarly.com and Clients for use as intended by Grammarly.com and Clients.

Give Grammarly.com the right to terminate Affiliate’s Grammarly.com affiliate account if there is inactivity during any twelve (12) month period, which includes but is not limited to (i) no impressions, clicks, leads, or sales generated, (ii) not responding to emails from the Grammarly.com Affiliate Marketing Manager, or (iii) having an incomplete account profile. If account is terminated, any unpaid Commissions will be paid out, regardless of whether applicable thresholds have been met.

Give Grammarly.com the right to terminate Affiliate’s Grammarly.com Affiliate account and void all Commissions earned if Affiliate fails to provide legitimate and proper payment details (e.g. working Payoneer address, mailing address, direct deposit information, etc).

Should Affiliate choose to leave the Affiliate Program, Affiliate shall notify Grammarly.com by email to: affiliate_mktg@grammarly.com. Any amount due to Affiliate that is twenty-five United States Dollars ($25) or greater will be paid during the immediately subsequent billing cycle. Failure to notify Grammarly.com of program departure will result in any payment due to Affiliate being forfeited unless the amount is over one hundred United States Dollars ($100).

The following additional program-specific terms shall apply to any promotional programs set forth below:

Advertising Campaigns. No Links can appear to be associated with or be positioned on chat rooms or bulletin boards unless otherwise agreed by Grammarly.com in writing. Any pop-ups/unders used for the Affiliate Program shall be clearly identified as Affiliate served in the title bar of the window and any client-side ad serving software used by Affiliate shall only have been installed on an end-user's computer if the function of the software is clearly disclosed to end-users prior to installation, the installation is pursuant to an affirmatively accepted and plain-english end user license agreement and the software be easily removed according to generally accepted methods.

3. Trademark Policy

You may not use the trademarked names “Grammarly” and/or “Grammarly.com” in any manner, including keyword bidding on search engines or any variation or misspellings thereof, in metatags or to direct traffic to any website other than our website. You may not use “Grammarly” and/or “Grammarly.com” in any manner or any variation or misspellings in your domain name.

4. Keyword Bidding Rules

You may not bid on any keyword or keyword string on any Pay per Click Search Engines (PPCSEs) where such keyword or keywords string is, or includes, one of our Trademarks (see the list of protected SEM bidding keywords below):

grammarly, www.essayrater.com, www.grammarly.com, essayrater.com, grammarly.com, essay rater, grammarly, sentenceworks, essayrater, gramarly.com, gramarly

Additionally, we prohibit bidding on the following non-brand keywords:

gramerly, gramerly.com, grammerly, grammerly.com, plagiarism checker, grammar check, plagiarism check, free plagiarism checker, plagiarism, grammar checker, grammar, plagiarism checker free, grammar check free, proofreading

In order to bid on brand term-discount term concatenations (i.e. Grammarly coupon, grammarly discount, grammarly deal, and variations thereof), you must obtain written consent from Grammarly's affiliate marketing team at: affiliate_mktg@grammarly.com

5. Confidentiality

You agree that all information, including, without limitation, the terms of this Agreement, business and financial information, customer and vendor lists, and pricing and sales information, concerning Grammarly or any of its affiliates or subsidiaries shall be held by you in strict confidence and shall not be utilized, directly or indirectly, by you for any purpose other than the participation in the Affiliate Program. Confidential Information shall not include information that is generally known or available to the public through a source other than disclosure by Affiliate. Affiliate shall not use any information obtained from the Affiliate Program to develop, enhance or operate a service that is competitive with the Affiliate Program, or assist another party, directly or indirectly, to do the same.

6. Publicity

Affiliate shall not use Grammarly’s name or logo, or refer to Grammarly in any marketing materials, without Grammarly’s prior written approval in each instance. Such approval shall be in Grammarly’s sole discretion and revocable at any time.
